responsibility: This definition module declares the `DynamicStrings.String` interface to common filesystem operations in the gm2 libraries. It belongs to the OS utility layer and exports `Exists`, `IsDir`, `IsFile`, `Unlink`, and `Access` on managed strings, pairing the higher-level `String` pathname abstraction with the `AccessMode` type imported from `CFileSysOp`.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the StringFileSysOp pair: it declares filesystem operations for `DynamicStrings.String` pathnames, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/StringFileSysOp.mod` implements them by passing C-style pointers to `CFileSysOp`.
